subject: Shadow Temple Entrance
text: Using Din's Fire in the chamber down the stairs after playing the Nocturne of Shadow lights all torches and unlocks the entrance to the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Play the Nocturne of Shadow, then go down the stairs to a 
small chamber.  Use Din's Fire to light all the torches and unlock the
entrance.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: To defeat Bongo Bongo, stun the hands with arrows, locate the central eye in the head using the Lens of Truth, shoot the eye with an arrow, and strike it with the sword.

evidence.quote:
When you reach the boss, first shoot the hands with 
arrows to stun them, then use the Lens of Truth to find the central eye in the
head.  Shoot that with an arrow, then slice it up with your sword.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: The dungeon map is inside a chest found by taking the passage to the right revealed with the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth to find a passage to the right; enter and get the map
  from the chest.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: The Hover Boots are in a chest obtained after going through the western door and defeating Dead Hand.

evidence.quote:
Find the door to the west and go through, kill the Dead Hand and get the
  Hover Boots from the chest.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: The compass is inside a chest obtained after going through the fake wall and defeating the enemies.

evidence.quote:
Go through the fake wall on the opposite side, kill the enemies and get the
  compass from the chest.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Collecting all the silver rupees awards a key.

evidence.quote:
Get all the silver rupees and get the key, then go back to the previous 
  room.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the room beyond the platform reached across the invisible platforms past the guillotines.

evidence.quote: Kill all the enemies, then kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) in the room beyond.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is inside the cage on the right side of the falling spike trap room.

evidence.quote: Enter the cage on the right, and kill the Gold Skulltula (#2).

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Climbing the block, jumping right to step on the switch, and jumping back rewards a key from a chest.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the block at the end to the top, jump to the right and step on the
  switch, then jump back over to the chest and get the key from it.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is found behind the giant statue.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula (#3) behind the giant statue.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Throwing a bomb into the giant statue yields a key.

evidence.quote:
Climb up and throw a bomb into the statue to get a key, then go back to the
  previous room.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Bombing the debris in the southeast corner reveals a hidden chest containing a key when using the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the debris in the southeast corner and use the Lens of Truth to get a
  key from the hidden chest, then go through the locked door.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the far wall near the ship and its token can be retrieved with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the Gold Skulltula (#4) on the far wall and get the token with the
  Longshot.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Burning the walls with Din's Fire reveals a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Use Din's Fire to burn the walls and get the Boss Key from the chest.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind the giant rotating statues.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula (#5) behind the giant rotating statues.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: Defeating the enemies in the room beyond the south door reveals a chest with a key.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies and get the key from the chest.

subject: Haunted Wasteland
text: A Gold Skulltula is inside the small stone building reached after crossing the quicksand pit with the Hover Boots and following the red flags.

evidence.quote:
Cross the quicksand pit ahead with the
Hover Boots, then follow the single red flags across the desert until you
reach a tiny stone building.  Enter the building and drop down, then kill
the Gold Skulltula inside.

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: Following the Poe across the desert path using the Lens of Truth leads to Desert Colossus, where entering and exiting the Spirit Temple prompts Sheik to teach the Requiem of Spirit.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Lens of Truth, and follow the Poe.  He will lead you across the
invisible path through the desert until you reach the Desert Colossus, where
the entrance to the Spirit Temple is located.  Enter the dungeon, then exit,
and Sheik will appear and teach you this song.

subject: Desert Colossus
text: A Gold Skulltula is on one of the palm trees on the south side of Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote:
Look at the palm trees on the south side of the area, and kill the Gold
Skulltula on one of them.

subject: Desert Colossus
text: Bombing a cracked wall near the northern palm trees reveals a Great Fairy who teaches Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote:
Near the palm trees on the north side of the area, there is a cracked wall.
Bomb it and enter; the Great Fairy inside teaches you this spell.

subject: Desert Colossus
text: Dropping a bottled bug onto the soft soil patch directly in front of the Spirit Temple entrance as Young Link reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Change to Young Link and warp to this area.  Use a bottled bug on the soft
soil spot right in front of the dungeon entrance to get this Gold Skulltula.

subject: Desert Colossus
text: Riding the magic bean plant as Adult Link to a northern rock platform leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Plant a Magic Bean at that soft soil spot, then return here as Adult Link.
Ride the bean platform over to a rock platform on the north side, where 
there is another Gold Skulltula.

subject: Desert Colossus
text: Riding the magic bean platform and jumping off onto the stone structure in front of the dungeon entrance yields a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote:
Ride this same bean platform again, and jump off on top of the stone 
structure in front of the dungeon entrance to get the Heart Piece there.

subject: Twinrova
text: Block one sister's fire or ice beam and reflect it at the opposite sister several times until they merge, then absorb three shots of the same element to fire a beam that stuns her for sword attacks.

evidence.quote:
To defeat them, first
target one of the sisters and block the fire or ice ray she shoots, then 
reflect that ray onto the other sister to damage her.  After doing that 
several times, they will merge into one.  Absorb a fire or ice shot three 
times in a row and you will reflect a beam at her.  When she's stunned, slice
her up with your sword until she dies.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Collecting the silver rupees drops the cage door, and lighting the torches spawns a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote:
Collect the silver rupees to make the cage door fall, then light the torches
  and get the key from the chest that appears.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the far side of the cage in the room with silver rupees.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) on the other side of this cage, then go through
  the door to a previous room.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at the top of the climbable wall.

evidence.quote: Climb up the wall and shoot the Gold Skulltula (#2) at the top.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Striking the crystal spawns a chest containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
Hit the crystal to get Bombchus from the chest, then use a Bombchu to hit 
  the rock protruding from the wall, and go through the unlocked door.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Dropping down to the left and lighting torches in front of the giant statue spawns a chest with the dungeon map.

evidence.quote:
Drop down to the left, light the torches in front of the giant statue and
  get the map from the chest.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Collecting all silver rupees lights a torch, and lighting all torches with a Deku Stick spawns a chest containing a key.

evidence.quote:
Collect all the silver rupees to light a torch, then light all the torches
  in the room with a Deku Stick, then get the key from the chest that drops.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: A Gold Skulltula is positioned above the unlocked door after pulling the sun block into the light.

evidence.quote: Turn around and kill the Gold Skulltula (#3) above the door.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: The Silver Gauntlets are in a chest outside after defeating the Iron Knuckle as Young Link.

evidence.quote: Get the Silver Gauntlets from the chest.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol spawns a chest containing the compass.

evidence.quote:
Play the Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol and get the compass from the
  chest.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the blue block after collecting the silver rupees reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Collect the silver rupees, then play the Song of Time in front of the blue
  block and kill the Gold Skulltula (#4).

subject: Spirit Temple
text: A key is located in the room following the blue block room.

evidence.quote:
Go to the next room and get the key, then go back two rooms, and go through
  the locked door.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the statue hand with the Triforce symbol allows Hookshotting to a chest holding a key.

evidence.quote:
Play Zelda's Lullaby, then hookshot to the chest
  and get the key from it.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song at the top of the west stairs allows Hookshotting over to Pierre to kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the stairs on the west side of the room to get to the top, play the
  Scarecrow's Song, then hookshot over to him and kill the Gold Skulltula 
  (#5).

subject: Spirit Temple
text: The Mirror Shield is found inside a chest after defeating an Iron Knuckle.

evidence.quote: Get the Mirror Shield from the chest.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Reflecting light onto the sun symbol in the Armos statue room unlocks a door to a room containing a key.

evidence.quote:
Get the key, then go back to the previous room, and west, then go through
  the locked door.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Shooting the door left of the flames reveals a golden eye to shoot, allowing Link to Hookshot across and step on a switch for the Boss Key chest.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the door to the left of the flames, then shoot the golden eye behind
  it.  Hookshot to the target and step on the switch, then get the Boss Key
  from the chest.

subject: Spirit Temple Mirror Puzzle
text: Bomb the cracked wall near the first mirror statue, point that mirror through the wall to the second mirror statue, and aim the second mirror to reflect light through the bars.

evidence.quote:
Hit the crystal through the bars, then go through the passage until you 
  reach a mirror statue.  Bomb the cracked wall, then push that mirror 
  statue so that it points to the statue through the wall, then push the 
  second mirror statue so it reflects light through the bars.

subject: Spirit Temple Central Platform
text: Reflecting light with the Mirror Shield onto the sun symbol lowers the central platform.

evidence.quote:
Go back around and reflect the light with your Mirror Shield onto the sun
  symbol to lower the platform.
